releases.displayName: The Military Gear Update is out now!

items.text: In preparation for tomorrows tinyBuild Connect, (which we have on good authority our favourite ducks will be attending), the feathered fiends have geared themselves up and are ready for action with the Military Gear Update!
In this update players can now equip and wear all items of clothing, helmets and armor crafted or found around the archipelago, which are then visible on your duck and every other duck you encounter.
Previously, armor and clothing could be equipped but would not alter your ducks appearance.
Check out some of the new threads here 👇
The team are working on some cool stuff right now, and we can't wait to share some of what's planned with you all in the coming weeks, so stay tuned!

See you in the skies!
tinyBuild Riga
Hey Everyone!

We’re seeing out the first month of the year with a new update for DUCKSIDE, which includes the implementation of the first iteration of one of our roadmap goals; weapon durability, alongside a bunch of balancing tweaks, QOL improvements and general optimization.
Check out the full update notes below!
The “Durability” feature is introduced for melee weapons. We will continue to extend this feature and fine-tune the ‘durability’ levels, while also adding a repair option in the near future.

Players can now throw small and large explosive charges onto walls from a distance, similar to the satchel charge mechanic in other games. This replaces the previous method of directly placing C4 on walls, adding a new layer of strategy and skill to breaching tactics.

notes.title: Added a second exit to the submarine

items.text: Previously, the submarine had only one exit, making it easy to camp. A second exit has been introduced to improve balance and reduce camping.
NPCs now attempt to take cover behind walls, crates, and other objects instead of standing still or running unpredictably.

A new sensitivity setting has been added specifically for scoped weapons. Players can now fine-tune their mouse sensitivity separately for collimator sights and 4x scopes, allowing for more precise aiming customization.
Administrators and Moderators can now issue Steam game bans directly from the in-game admin panel.
The team marker system has been overhauled to reduce confusion:
Players can now place one group-visible marker using Ctrl + Left Mouse Button
Each player can set up to 5 personal markers
Team leaders have the ability to remove group markers placed by other team members
Implemented some visual fixes and general optimization
Let us know what you think of the update in the comments, and tell us what you'd like to see added to the game in the future!

releases.displayName: The Christmas Update is available now!

items.text: The festive season is upon us! So for their first Christmas on the DUCKSIDE archipelago, the Ducks are celebrating it in style with a Christmas Update!
Quacked with new features, holiday-themed items, a brand new monument and more. Let’s unwrap the highlights! Read through the end for the full patch notes!

Somehow, someone got a submarine stranded in the middle of the desert. Gross incompetence of whoever was captaining that submarine aside, it holds some valuable loot for anyone brave enough to venture to its heart and extract it…
Get ready for some merry mayhem!
Who ya gonna call? Not Scrooge, that’s for sure. The Ghostly Ducks of Christmas yet to come are haunting bases across the archipelago.
Drops new gatherable resource
Snow Piece: Used for crafting Xmas themed items!
Santa (or a feathered non-union equivalent) is visiting to spread joy and cultivate carnage.
While shooting "Santa's” sleigh would usually get you put pretty high up on the naughty list, it is the most efficient way of getting your hands on his loot…
The bravest ducks may also find even rarer loot in the sleigh itself…
Santa Hat: I mean, what other kind of hat do you expect at Christmas…?
Deer Antlers: Become an honorary member of Santa's reindeer alongside Rudolph, Donner, Dancer and whatever the other ones are called!
Snowman Keep a cool head in even the toughest situations!
Krampus Hat: For all the ducks out there that still enjoy christmas but wanna maintain their edgy and mysterious persona.
Door Skin: Nothing says “It’s Christmas” like a wreath on the door of a base that you’re about to turn to rubble.
Fireplace Warm those webbed feet by the fire as you await the arrival of santa (or a raider) with a Christmas Fireplace
And more! : Christmas lights, candy cane weapons, streamer shotguns and Christmas tree shrines can also be crafted and found throughout the archipelago!
Snowman: Ever wanted to blow up a snowman with a rocket launcher? Of course you have, and now you can!
(Please note that you don’t actually get anything out of it other than the satisfaction of having blown up a snowman with a rocket launcher)
Snowmen can be built by default.
With this update, we have completed the first phase of our Roadmap and have updated it to reflect our goals for the coming months, which you can see below:

Also, we have put together a player satisfaction survey to help us understand our players experiences with the game, what could be improved, what you would most like to see added and your overall opinion of DUCKSIDE, and we would appreciate it if you could take 10 minutes to help us out here by filling it out
New monument - Submarine in the Desert Island
Introduced a new unique automatic shotgun (Vulture's Wrath) with enhanced fire rate
Weather system
Updated vending machine locations on the map
Added a feature to display the list of items available in each vending machine directly in the map UI
Added an optional setting for using the global moderators list in the admin panel
Adjusted bleeding mechanics
Added a bleeding effect to the barbed wire trap
Fixes
Resolved localization issues and display errors in various game elements
Adjusted sleeping ducks to have proper HP, matching normal ducks
Ensured blueprints now appear in the inventory, even if it is full at the time of purchase
Corrected furnace behavior where activating it instantly burned wood and created charcoal without delay
Added proper death location display for players who died offline
Updated the postmortem screen to correctly display destroyed bases and nests
Fixed access to the Idol so players can now interact only when registered at the base.
Enabled Tesla coils and shotgun traps to properly react to admins under m1/m2 commands.
Resolved an issue where players with their own base were unable to disassemble wooden buildings or use workbenches and research tables
Improved door interaction interfaces for players registered with an Idol
Resolved an issue that allowed players registered at a base to disassemble nests owned by others after a server restart
Fixed outline masking issues with hats
Restored availability of NVIDIA Reflex and Frame Generation features
Removed limitations on C4 usage when 20 landmines are placed
Removed rockets from the crafted rocket launcher
Optimizations
General Performance Improvements
Optimized buildings unloading upon destruction to improve performance and reduce FPS drops
Graphics and Animations
Replaced falling animations with smoother transitions
Updated animations for walking, weapon handling, and interaction movements
Added new military textures for NPC gear
Added new transition animations for boosts and movement speed changes
Added animations for reloading the bazooka
New Christmas-themed hats, decorations, and items added to the game
Santa's Sleigh was added, bringing festive gifts to players
Miscellaneous
Weather settings UI for admins to display current and manual adjustments
Added notification system for player registration acceptance
Fixed base deregistration issues when the core idol object is destroyed
Known Issues
Certain changes require further testing to prevent rare server crashes
Minor visual glitches may occur on specific systems

Introducing a new island, thanksgiving themed skins and hats, quality of life improvements, and a ton of fixes and reworks, there’s no better time that now to rejoin the flock 🦆

Pilgrim Hat: Top off your duck’s look with a classic Pilgrim hat

Baked Turkey Skin: Turn your duck into a delicious, golden-brown roasted turkey
Turkey door: Give those pesky eco-raiding ducks something nice to look at while they spend an hour slowly trying to break down your door with a thanksgiving turkey emblem
Duck Island: Explore a new location with... familiar looking stone figures.
Offline Death Screen: Players can now view who eliminated them while they were offline, providing closure and valuable intel for revenge planning
Fixed landscape collisions
Introduced bleeding effect
Bandages are now applied faster
Moderator role added, players can now apply for moderator permissions

Hey all!
It’s been just over a month since we launched DUCKSIDE into Early Access and we’re absolutely blown away by the response we’ve seen so far!

Today, we’re going to update you on what’s going on at the DUCKSIDE HQ, with some details about upcoming major additions, our next patch and some organizational improvements we’ve made to improve the player experience in DUCKSIDE…

First off, we have now established a dedicated cheat prevention admin team to manage player reports. Previously, we had no dedicated personnel to handle the deluge of reports we had been receiving, with the team members instead dealing with them on an ad-hoc basis. With the introduction of our new admin team, we are in a much better position to address player reports, cheats and hackers in a more organized and timely manner.
Implementation of a new Anti-cheat system

EAC has been holding the fort for us since our first beta all the way back in April, but there are some essential features we need for this style of game that the platform doesn’t offer at this time. So in the interest of improving the security of the game and maintaining our community's enjoyment of DUCKSIDE, we will soon be implementing a new anti-cheat system which has proven successful in other similar titles that we hope will be more suited to our needs.
New monument - Stranded submarine

The Early Access release saw the introduction of the Oil Rig, which marked a new approach to how we design our monuments and is something we will be continuing with our next major monument: The Stranded Submarine.
Work is well underway and we hope to have this introduced either before the end of the year, or early 2025. We will keep you updated on our efforts!

At this moment in time, tools don’t degrade with use, making eco raiding a lengthy but extremely viable option for anyone who wants to save their resources and are willing to dedicate their time to it. The team are working to implement a weapon durability system that will ideally shift the raiding emphasis back to designated raiding equipment, requiring more skill, planning and rarer resources.
Thanksgiving Update/Event
These ducks love a national holiday, especially if it means that other birds have to deal with the humans wrath for a few days....
New hats, new skins, new base decoration items and more are coming to DUCKSIDE in celebration of Thanksgiving this November!
Check out some concept art 👇

Finally, let’s take an Early look at what's planned for the next upcoming patch which we’ve built around some of the most common reports and feedback we’ve received from players over the last few weeks.
We’re hoping to release this update later this week or early next:
Bug Fixes
Fixing a bug with placing a floor door
Fixing a bug with determining stability in construction (objects could hang in the air after destruction).
Fixing a bug with a triangular floor, where it was impossible to place walls under an improved floor.
Fixing dismantling triangular doors without an idol.
Fixing dismantling objects (e.g., workbenches) not giving crafting kits in the base without an idol.
Fixing that there was no animation of a character's shot when aiming for a local player.
Gameplay Improvements
Shot validation - fewer missed shots.
Removed the check for player spawn, so they are not teleported to a random spawn during a collision.
Molotov will now damage sleeping ducks.
Adding zoom while aiming.
Base registration improvements.
Anti-Cheat and Reporting
Players will no longer be able to spam reports.
Anti-cheat will now show report ID, allowing users to appeal to EAC with it.
Map and Content Updates
Map - adding 2 cave systems.
Weapon Modifications
Weapon modifications: bullet speed increase, recoil change.

This is a tentative list, and we will be monitoring player feedback to further identify anything that we can resolve in time for the patch. So if you have anything you feel needs urgently addressing, please don’t hesitate to let us know!
